schema.name: Undaria Algae™ Body Oil
schema.description:
Clinically shown to instantly improve the look of skin elasticity and deliver deep moisturization. Our seaweed-infused body oil is a rush of antioxidant-rich hydration that softens, nourishes and firms like no other. Rich yet never greasy, this intoxicating aromatherapy elixir enhances every inch. Mineralize, moisturize and glow!
Also available in fragrance-free, which is hypoallergenic, dermatologist tested and safe for sensitive skin.
To create this one-of-a-kind oil, we soak hand-harvested Undaria Algae™ in barrels of oils to infuse the vitamins and minerals. Due to the artisanal manner of production, variation in color is normal. This oil contains Undaria Seaweed and as such, a naturally occurring seaweed sediment may be present at the bottom of your bottle. This is completely normal and does not affect the quality or efficacy of the product.

schema.name: Anti-Aging Body Balm
schema.description:
Our Best-Selling Anti-Aging Body Balm
Our silky body balm combines the lasting hydration of a lotion with the anti-aging benefits of a serum. Formulated to target body skin, Alaria seaweed improves the appearance of skin elasticity and makes skin feel firmer all over. This super-nourishing body treatment softens skin with a combination of passion fruit, coconut, acai and babassu oils. All-day body hydration while you glow!
As this product contains natural oils, a variance in texture and color is normal.

schema.name: Undaria Algae™ Body Wash
schema.description:
Seaweed-boosted body wash effectively cleanses and removes impurities, leaving skin soft, smooth and revitalized. Daily pH-balanced formula mineralizes without stripping skin. Skin-loving ingredients aloe and glycerin hydrate to help support skin’s moisture barrier.
Created with our iconic Undaria Algae™ Body Oil scent for an uplifting and intoxicating shower experience.

schema.name: Undaria Body Bestsellers
schema.description:
Give the gift of seaweed-powered glow with this limited-edition duo of full-size Undaria body bestsellers that visibly firm, deeply hydrate and leave skin radiant.
Undaria Algae™ Body Lotion delivers lightweight, instant and lasting hydration while visibly firming skin. Undaria Algae™ Body Oil deeply moisturizes, visibly improves elasticity and boosts glow. Use alone or layer the oil over lotion to lock in moisture.

schema.name: Hyaluronic Body Serum
schema.description:
Hyaluronic Body Serum
Clinical Results, lightweight body serum instantly boosts skin’s hydration by 161%. Improves your natural moisture barrier for visibly healthy, smooth skin. Formulated for body usage only.
